findings: The pinned 3DMatch dataset-format evidence identifies frame-XXXXXX.color.png as 24-bit RGB, frame-XXXXXX.depth.png as the aligned 16-bit depth for the same frame identity, depth units as millimetres with raw zero invalid, camera-intrinsics.txt as the depth-camera K, and frame-XXXXXX.pose.txt as a metre-valued camera-to-world matrix.

The adapter preserves native 640x480 identity, decodes RGB as uint8 RGB and depth as uint16, converts optical-axis Z by raw/1000, retains raw zero invalidity without filling or clipping, and keeps the optional 3DMatch fusion-only six-metre rejection out of the measurement contract.

The half-pixel rule is supported by pinned 3DMatch training code and VMem's arange+0.5 image grid. The 640x480 to 768x576 area resize followed by left-96 crop gives K576 [[648.0254784,0,288],[0,648.0254784,288],[0,0,1]], consistent with pinned VMem preprocessing and with the current predictor interface.

The adapter parses proper-rotation homogeneous C2W poses in metres, retains the original optical convention (+X right, +Y down, +Z forward), and exposes the VMem Y/Z column flip separately; pinned VMem get_cond performs the same column flip before inversion.

The frozen development window is strictly chronological (history 0,15,30,45; command cameras 60,75,90,105). All 13 staged predictor records matched their declared byte counts and SHA-256 values, each command-camera matrix exactly matched its declared source pose, and no hardware timestamp or blind pose-prediction claim is made.

The adapter rejects noncanonical, traversal, symlinked, outside-root, unhashed, size-mismatched, hash-mismatched, unsupported-path, and unsupported-role reads. The current read-only stage contains only four history RGB files, four history poses, four command-camera JSON files, one camera-intrinsics JSON, and its predictor manifest; it contains no depth file and no target/future RGB file. The independent exact-boundary receipt additionally records dataset/project invisibility and no future outcome bytes opened.
limitations: Acceptance is limited to the exact scene13 development adapter SHA and the declared exposed development window; it does not qualify scene14, any held-out window, any model forward, any score, or any method claim.
The poses are RGB-D Mapping estimates rather than motion-capture ground truth, and frame order is used only as chronology because the converted source does not provide hardware timestamps.

The 0.5 pixel-centre convention is a declared 3DMatch-training/VMem compatibility choice; the retained 3DMatch fusion demo uses a different integer-raster rounding convention, so this acceptance is not a claim of a universal physical sensor convention.

The adapter's Python allowlist is not an operating-system sandbox. Future-payload isolation depends on the separately bound read-only stage and container mount whitelist documented by the exact-boundary receipt.
Depth resizing is a separately declared nearest-cell evaluation helper and is not used by load_history or by the current RGB-only predictor input path.
attestation: I independently reviewed the complete adapter at the stated SHA, the source and VMem evidence/manifests, the qualification record and runner, and the current window/predictor/isolation bindings. I did not inspect any future RGB or depth payload, did not run a model or GPU workload, and did not modify the remote project. Every required check above is supported; ADAPTER_ACCEPTED is restricted to the stated adapter/data-contract scope and does not authorize a forward or assert Gate0 completion.
